name: pix-highlighter
title: Pix Highlighter
description: Browser-native syntax highlighting Web Component. Uses the CSS Highlight API for zero-runtime, zero-dependency code highlighting.

name: pix-foundations
title: Pix Foundations
description: Centralised design tokens for radii, spacing, colors, typography, focus, and elevations. Uses light-dark() for automatic theme support.

name: pix-toast
title: Pix Toast
description: Accessible toast notification system with smart queuing, deduplication, and auto-dismiss. Includes both individual toast and stack manager.

name: pix-sortable
title: Pix Sortable
description: Accessible sortable list with drag & drop, touch support, and full keyboard navigation. WCAG 2.2 AA.

name: pix-splitter
title: Pix Splitter
description: Accessible resizable panel splitter Web Component. Supports horizontal and vertical layouts with keyboard navigation.

name: pix-color
title: Pix Color
description: Accessible OKLCH color picker with HEX, RGB, HSL, and OKLCH formats. Includes WCAG contrast checking and native form support.

name: pix-recorder
title: Pix Recorder
description: Accessible audio recorder with waveform visualization, pause/resume, download, and WCAG 2.2 AA support.

name: pix-vanilla-reactive
title: Pix Vanilla Reactive
description: Zero-dependency reactive UI framework: Proxy Store, fine-grained Signals, html`` template engine, and custom elements.

name: pix-command
title: Pix Command
description: Accessible command palette Web Component with fuzzy search, keyboard navigation, and category grouping.

name: pix-a11y-panel
title: Pix Display Preferences
description: Accessible popover Web Component for managing display preferences: color scheme, accent color, reduced motion, and typography settings.

name: pix-accent-color-selector
title: Pix Accent Color Selector
description: Accent color selector Web Component. Lets users pick a custom accent color that syncs with the system and persists across sessions.

name: pix-color-scheme-selector
title: Pix Color Scheme Selector
description: Color scheme selector Web Component. Provides a light / dark / system toggle that respects the user's OS-level preference.

name: coming-soon
title: Coming Soon...
description: New components are being developed. Stay tuned for more accessible, zero-dependency vanilla JS Web Components.
